metadata.title: The Cohomological Price of NOT
metadata.description: The decrease invariant d(f) governing negation complexity acquires a cohomological address: on the dual-rail four-valued lattice, the character chi_sigma of the Klein four-group V4 is the unique character pricing negation (with two-sided separating witnesses), and d(f) equals the minimal length of a nested chi_sigma-tower, with an explicit three-zone witness h = 1 / not-f / 0 by decrease-potential zone for the upper bound and an alternation argument for the lower bound. All 19 theorems are machine-verified in core Lean 4 (axioms propext and Quot.sound only; character tables axiom-free; no native_decide, no sorry). Produced in collaboration with an AI research pipeline operated by the author, with the Lean 4 kernel as the final acceptance gate.
